scope: Bounded read-only mailbox source review; no implementation/test/dump/device action.
answer: Yes: after a successful completed Dispatch, before the handle/mailbox is reused, the existing mailbox can describe actual state-equality classes WITHIN a single(owner,logicalQP lane,invocation epoch) by peer->q indices produced by state_addr deduplication. It also retains published generation and helperACK generation. This reduces the need for new exports for that limited scoped mapping; it does not provide complete nativeDomain or cross-scope alias identity.

layout.base: handle._peer_plan + plan_mailbox_offset; header word6*4 supplies offset; task=owner+8*lane

fields.0: published s.magic generation, written last after metadata cache clean/DDR ordering

layout.warning: Read only q_for_currentlane in that lane private peer table. Otherlane default0 is not a queue-equivalence fact.

findings.finding: InitClosSplit builds private x.lane.peers/queues; x.qp derives physicalrole, owner fromrole. For each CROSS-SERVER peer, fetch SDKctx then search lanequeues for matching ctx->state_addr; allocate q only on a newstate. Set peer.queue[x.qp]=q; otherlane queue member stays defaultzero. Within same scope equalq therefore same fetchedstate, differentq represents distinct fetchedstate at initialization.

Local-server peer is assigned peer.peer but skipped before ctx lookup and q assignment. Its default q0 fields are NOT valid mapping. Exclude peer//8==rank//8 before deriving equality groups, even though peer_count includes it.

PublishClosRelayAssist snapshots queue_count/peer_count and all peerq fields, then publishes generation LAST. It publishes after phase0SO submission and uses immutable CQEsnapshot targets, not liveSQstate export.

Every queue snapshot starts fourzero words; critical_rows==0 skips SO1/CQ snapshot entirely. Peer->q and queue_count remain usable within scope; allzero CQrecord does not mean noqueue or alias with otherzero records. Record[3] is a phaseSO ticket, not a row frontier.

For nonzero critical queues, source verifies CQstate_addr==queue.state then snapshots CQ buffer+ticket slot, ownerbit,physicalQP,ticket. The mailbox never stores actual state_addr itself. Neither address of oneCQslot nor distinctsnapshot addresses alone is a complete queueidentity.

Helper drains readiness writes before publishing ACK; FinishClosSplit observes finalCQ, waits itsACK then quiets actualqueues. Pressurequiet in phase1 also waitsACK before CQslotreuse. AfterACK/successfulDispatch the stored CQEpointer can be stale/reused; parsing its numeric snapshot is possible, dereferencing it as livecompletion evidence is not.

Header word3 is zero at publication but protocol permits profiling reuse afterACK (and reserved profile fields). Exclude mutable/profile words3.. from identity/equality inference. The bounded current publisher review does not establish a postACK liveprofilevalue.

Notify initializes mailbox storage tozero; cachedDispatch republishes owner/lane taskmetadata at eachgeneration. A nextNotify/reuse or nextDispatch can overwrite records. Persistenthandle lifetime is not a guarantee of immutable mailbox contents.

safe_snapshot_requirements: Only relevant successful cross-server split-QP Dispatch worlds>=16; EP<=8 does not populate these tasktables.

Capture copiedtask metadata after a known successful device completion and before ANY reuse of this handle/mailbox or later generation. Native_return alone is not device completion. Bind external session/run/dispatchgeneration, not merely matching all task0 values.

For each(owner,lane):validate task0 expectedgeneration, ACKword64 expectedgeneration, boundedqueue_count/peer_count; parse only actualpeercount/queuecount, exclude localserverpeer, use only currentlane q and bounds q<queue_count.

Interpret equality only as(owner,lane,generation,q). Keep scoped peers grouped when they shareq. No merging scopes merely because q numbers/zeroCQs match. No claiming cross-scope disjointness merely because q differs.
Do not readthrough storedCQE pointers afterACK; queue retirement may already recycleCQ slots. Do not use snapshot SO1ticket/pressurecontrol as tile-ready frontier.
remaining_native_alias_gaps: No actualSQstate_addr or SDKslot is stored, so crossowner/lane state aliases cannot be resolved from this scoped q map alone.
FM privateQP0, localMTE writers, auxiliaryMTE and any otheroperator queues are outside this table.
CQpointer/physicalQP/ticket snapshots cover SO1critical queues only; critical_rows0 has noCQidentity at all.
Cannot derive dynamic perrow issueorder/seq or seal notifications from these records.
Snapshot scheduling/lifetime export still absent; no realdump/capturedgeneration verifies these source-derived constraints.
